title: upstream crosslink: settings merge clobbers the hooks block wholesale
description: Upstream finding for dollspace-gay/crosslink, 2026-07-20. Observation from source: write_settings_json_merged unions allowedTools (preserving user additions, merge.rs:194-214) but overwrites hooks and enableAllProjectMcpServers wholesale as crosslink-managed (merge.rs:216-222) — adopter hook customizations are silently lost on update. The manifest-hash trick (hash template before allowedTools union so user additions do not register as drift, init/mod.rs:357-362) is excellent and worth extending to hooks via a managed-section or refusal pattern. Related: vsdd's statusline offer chose refuse-on-existing for adopter-owned statusLine — a stated divergence from this clobber behavior.
